parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds all other parts such as doors, shelves, and drawers in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that maintains the cabinet’s shape and stability.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on design.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF with a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the right storage compartment and protects contents from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged MDF panel with a handle for access.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left storage compartment and conceals stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right drawer is a sliding storage compartment made of plywood with a metal handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides enclosed storage for small items and slides in and out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along metal tracks for opening and closing.

parts.name: Drawer (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left drawer is a sliding compartment made of plywood with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It stores small items and slides outward for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails for opening and closing.

parts.name: Rectangular Hole (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The rectangular hole is an open space within the cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cutout or opening for fitting components or providing ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static void and does not move.
